results.title: Taylor's Sunday Evening First Alert Forecast
results.description: We’re not escaping the heat and humidity for a while! Temperatures will drop in to the mid 70s overnight tonight, and it will remain muggy. There’s a chance for a few isolated showers and storms this evening, but many of us will stay dry. Monday will be another hot and humid day with highs in the low to mid 90s. The heat index will climb above 100 at times. It's going to get hotter by the end of the week with highs in the mid to upper 90s. Here's the latest forecast.

results.title: Kyle’s $99 show falls apart within minutes
results.description: Kyle Sandilands’ subscription radio show Kyle Sandilands Live got off to a shambolic start on Monday morning, plagued by tech issues – and with one member of Sandilands’ team dropping the C-bomb six minutes into the show.
